Railway model dataset in Shapefile format - Contains 4 layers: 1: Railway Links: sections of the railway at track level between nodes, showing the track centreline. Links terminate at buffer stops or switches / crossings; 2: Railway Nodes: points marking the ends of Railway Links. Can have between 1 and 4 connected Railway Links; 3: Railway Reference Lines: virtual lines which have been generated by creating a best fit between the main lines of each Engineer’s Line Reference (ELR) and as such are generalised and not a seamless linear feature.; 4: Network Waymarks: locations of mileposts. Full details in the Open Data Technical Specification.

MoveOD is a framework for synthesizing fine-grained origin-destination (OD) demand data for transportation cyber-physical systems. It combines GTFS-based fixed-line transit planning, on-demand mobility services, and OD demand estimation into a full-stack application with a FastAPI backend and React frontend. The system integrates multiple data sources -- LODES (employment), INRIX (traffic), OpenStreetMap (buildings/POIs), and Census geographies -- and applies integer linear programming (ILP) calibration to produce building-level OD matrices suitable for digital twin simulations and transit planning.
